author: @alice
text: Reminder for everyone: when building new services, OAuth 2.1 PKCE is now mandatory. Read DOC_AUTH_SPEC for key rotation details.

author: @bob
text: Thanks Alice! I am testing the new Keycloak client with our Python FastAPI gateway. Bob and Carol are meeting at 2pm on billing.

author: @davidk
text: Heads up: Kubernetes 1.30 upgrade is scheduled for this Sunday. Elena has confirmed security policies are in place.

author: @elena
text: Just completed security review of PRJ_OAUTH_UPGRADE. No blocking vulnerabilities found, token expiry at 15 mins approved.

author: Alice Chen
text: We are enforcing PKCE S256 challenge codes at the gateway level. Anyone trying to send plain text code_challenge will get a 400 Bad Request.

author: bmartinez
text: Got it @alice. I have updated our gateway middleware to reject plain challenges.

author: @bob
text: Drafted DOC_TELEMETRY_STANDARD for OpenTelemetry structured JSON logging. Please review PR #108.

author: Ro
text: Looking at the telemetry spec now Bob. Adding trace_id and span_id to all outgoing Stripe webhook handlers.

author: @davidk
text: Elasticsearch cluster is ingesting JSON logs cleanly now. Trace correlation works across auth and billing services.

author: Elena Rostova
text: TICK-105 is created for automated RS256 key rotation every 90 days. We need JWKS endpoints cached with a 1-hour grace period.

author: @alice
text: Agreed Elena. Alice Chen will implement the JWKS public key publisher pod.

author: @bob
text: Stripe Billing V2 integration is officially live for all North American credit card processing.

author: Pri
text: Congrats Bob! Payments team is synchronizing with Stripe webhooks for cross-currency reconciliation.

author: karan
text: Backend gateway latency dropped from 85ms to 24ms after switching session validation to local JWT verification!

author: @alice
text: Great to see! That was the primary goal of PRJ_OAUTH_UPGRADE.

author: dkim
text: Redis pods in production have been migrated to IAM IRSA authentication. No more DB passwords in config maps.

author: @elena
text: Audit complete for TICK-302. Closed as resolved.

author: fwright
text: Frontend portal is ready to consume the new OAuth refresh token rotation cookies.

author: Alice Chen
text: Setting SameSite=Strict and Secure flags on the auth cookies. Frank Wright please verify in staging.

author: @frank
text: Verified in staging. Cookie exchange works flawlessly.
